payment.holiday_deferral_rule: If the payment date is a statutory holiday or rest day, it is postponed to the next working day, with no additional interest during the postponement period.

put.accrued_interest_rule: Repurchase at the bond face value plus accrued interest for the current period.
put.annual_exercise_limit: The holder may exercise the repurchase right once per interest year after the repurchase condition is first satisfied in that year.
put.put_price_rule: Repurchase at the bond face value plus accrued interest for the current period.

redemption.accrued_interest_redemption_rule: Redeem at the bond face value plus accrued interest for the current period.
redemption.maturity_redemption_price_rule: Redeem all unconverted convertible bonds at 120% of the face value (including the final year's interest).
